plot: The morning after the robot stopped, Max picks Grandma's flower show roses to say sorry and she goes quiet; Bird reveals the robot only needed charging, Max's try to plant the roses back fails, Bird's idea of a water jar saves them, and Max learns Grandma was only worried about his pricked paw; the bouquet wins a gold cup, and then a car brings a visitor called Luna.

beats.say: Surprise, Grandma! I picked you the biggest flowers in the garden!
Oh! Max! Those are my flower show roses!
Ouch! Prickly! Why does Grandma look so sad?
A bright morning in the garden. The day after the robot stopped.
Max felt so bad about the robot. So bad!
So he picked the biggest flowers he could find, to say sorry.
Grandma looks at Max's paw for a long, quiet moment.
Then she turns and goes inside. Without a word.
Tweet tweet! Big news! The robot works again! It was hungry!
Hungry for power? What does that mean, Bird?
Grandma plugged it in the wall. Zzzzt! Now it's happy again!
So I didn't break it? Then I said sorry for nothing!
And you picked Grandma's flower show roses! For nothing! Oh, Max!
Don't say it so loud! I was only trying to help!
Max looks at the roses. Then at the empty garden bed.
The flower show is this afternoon. And now there are no roses.
Grandma grew those roses all summer. Every single day!
Every day? Oh no. I made Grandma sad on her special day.
I have to fix this before the show. I just have to!
How do you un-pick a flower? Is that even a thing?
Easy. I put them back in the ground. Like new!
Max digs a little hole. Dig, dig, dig. Roses go in.
There! Stand up tall, roses. Stand up for Grandma!
The roses wobble. And wobble. And then... flop. They fall over.
Uh-oh. They look like they need a nap. A very long nap.
Flowers can't grow back once you pick them. Can they?
Nope. The roots stay in the ground. Like feet on a branch.
Max sits down in the grass. His tail droops low.
Grandma will never ask me to help her again.
Hey, don't be sad. Picked flowers can still stay pretty!
Stay pretty? How? They're already falling over.
Water! At the big park, people put flowers in jars of water.
The flowers drink and drink. They stay pretty for days and days!
A jar of water. Bird, that's actually a really good idea!
I have good ideas all the time. Nobody listens to me!
Max finds Grandma's old blue jar by the garden door.
Splash! Water in. Then, very gently, the roses go in too.
Drink up, roses. Please be pretty for Grandma.
Slurp, slurp. Slowly, the floppy roses stand up straight again.
Ooh! They look like a fancy party in a jar!
But the show wants roses in the ground. Not in a jar.
Wait! The show has a table for flower jars! Best Bouquet!
Best Bouquet? Then we still have a chance!
Only if Grandma says yes. And only if we hurry!
Max carries the jar to the door. Slowly. Not one drop spills.
Grandma? I'm sorry I picked your roses without asking.
Oh, Max. Show me your paw, dear. The ouch paw.
My paw? It's fine. Just one tiny prickle. Why?
Rose thorns are sharp. I was worried you got hurt, little one.
You weren't sad about the roses? You were sad about me?
Flowers grow again next summer. There is only one Max.
Grandma checks the paw. A tiny scratch. A little kiss. All better.
And look! Bird helped me save them. They're in a jar now!
A bouquet! Why, that's perfect for the Best Bouquet table!
Told you! Best idea of the day! Tweet tweet!
Thank you, Bird. From now on, I listen to you first.
That afternoon, the little blue jar sits on the show table.
And next to it... a shiny gold cup! Best Bouquet!
Our first prize ever! And we won it together.
Next time, I'll ask first. And we pick together, Grandma.
And next time, you listen to the chatty bird first!
Everyone laughs in the warm, sunny garden.
Then, honk, honk! A little car stops at the garden gate.
That's our visitor! Little Luna is here!
Luna? Who is Luna? And why is she coming to MY house?

long.title: Why Is Grandma Sad? Max Picked Her Show Roses 🌹🐱
long.description:
"I only wanted to say sorry. Why did it make things worse?" 🐱
Max picks Grandma's flower show roses to say sorry, and Grandma goes very quiet. With Bird's help he tries to fix it before the show, and learns why Grandma was really sad. Max the Curious Cat, Ep 14.
#MaxTheCuriousCat #series #3DAnimation
